create_face_recognition_pipeline: create a face recognition pipeline using PCA eigenfaces and SVM classification on the LFW dataset
build_pca_eigenfaces: build a PCA dimensionality reduction to extract eigenfaces from face image data
test_svm_classifier: test an SVM classifier with randomized hyperparameter search on PCA-projected face features
run_classification_evaluation: run a classification report and confusion matrix visualization on predicted face identities
create_plot_gallery: create a plot gallery function to display face images with prediction titles using matplotlib
